global_rule: Any status other than PASS, or any exit code other than 0, forbids GO.
environment_rule: An unavailable route, browser, dependency, dataset, access, authorization or mismatched SHA is not PASS; report BLOCKED with exit 75 for an external dependency, NOT_AUTHORIZED with exit 77 for missing authorization, or INVALID/NOT_RUN with exit 2 when the evidence is incomplete or incoherent.

objectives.name: provenance-git
objectives.target: CI SHA, package SHA and tested SHA are identical at 100%
objectives.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; git diff; sha256sum package.zip; provenance check
objectives.pass_rule: Every required SHA and provenance reference is identical.

objectives.name: diff-scope
objectives.target: 0 forbidden design or UX files modified
objectives.command: git diff --name-status a58942c..HEAD
objectives.pass_rule: No unauthorized CSS, template, asset, public text or UX file is modified.

objectives.name: local-quality
objectives.target: 5/5 quality controls exit 0
objectives.command: check.sh; PHP lint; PHPStan; git diff --check; git diff --cached --check
objectives.pass_rule: All five controls exit 0.

objectives.name: public-routes
objectives.target: 4/4 public routes HTTP 200 and valid REST JSON
objectives.command: HTTP matrix for home, archive, REST listings and REST root
objectives.pass_rule: All four routes satisfy status and JSON assertions.

objectives.name: estatik-notice
objectives.target: 0 public WP_Scripts::add notices on 4/4 routes
objectives.command: Cache-busted and normal HTML/JSON requests with notice scan
objectives.pass_rule: Zero occurrence on every declared route.

objectives.name: rest-lite-scope
objectives.target: 10/10 scope scenarios pass
objectives.command: Anonymous GET, authenticated/cookie/header requests, writes and other routes
objectives.pass_rule: All ten scenarios pass without exception.

objectives.name: rest-business-equivalence
objectives.target: 100% required fields identical or justified
objectives.command: Normal/light REST comparison for sale, rental, pagination, locale, image, price, city, URL and JSON-LD
objectives.pass_rule: Every required field is identical or has a documented justification.

objectives.name: sale-filter
objectives.target: a-vendre includes the expected fixture, a-louer excludes it, unknown action returns 0
objectives.command: Read-only localized HTTP/HTML assertions over the declared fixture
objectives.pass_rule: All inclusion, exclusion and field-preservation assertions pass for every required locale.

objectives.name: multilingual
objectives.target: 3/3 FR/EN/AR languages tested when required by the CDC
objectives.command: Complete localized route and data matrix
objectives.pass_rule: All required languages are tested and localized.

objectives.name: capacity-nominal
objectives.target: 10 RPS reads and 2 RPS writes with zero errors
objectives.command: Official 4-CPU CI capacity run
objectives.pass_rule: Both phases have zero errors and meet their declared targets.

objectives.name: capacity-burst
objectives.target: at least 24.75 RPS, p95 <= 1.5s, p99 <= 3s and CPU <= 80%
objectives.command: Official cold 4-CPU CI burst run
objectives.pass_rule: All four numerical criteria pass.

objectives.name: capacity-saturation
objectives.target: Complete 50 RPS saturation measurement with honest classification
objectives.command: 50 RPS saturation probe with RPS, latency, CPU and RSS
objectives.pass_rule: Measurement is complete and classified; saturation is not relabeled nominal PASS.

objectives.name: ttfb-contract
objectives.target: p95 <= 800ms on 4/4 routes with at least 20 measurements per route and source
objectives.command: Measure DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, total, HCDN and origin timings from two sources
objectives.pass_rule: Every route meets the p95 target and all phases are recorded.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Second source or Hostinger unavailable => 75; otherwise failed target => 1.

objectives.name: ttfb-attribution
objectives.target: 100% of client/TLS/HCDN/proxy/origin chain attributed
objectives.command: Correlate client timestamps, HCDN IDs, proxy data, PHP-FPM and slow logs
objectives.pass_rule: A reproducible technical cause is proven, not hypothesized.

objectives.name: visual-pixel
objectives.target: 30/30 scenarios with <= 0.5% diff and VISUAL_EXIT=0
objectives.command: Run the pinned pixel contract against the 30 versioned scenarios
objectives.pass_rule: All 30 scenarios pass on the final SHA.

objectives.name: official-baselines
objectives.target: 30 versioned PNGs and 30 concordant SHA256 hashes
objectives.command: Verify manifest count and every file hash
objectives.pass_rule: All 30 files and hashes match.

objectives.name: human-visual-review
objectives.target: One complete independent visual review signed
objectives.command: Independent review of design, responsive, RTL and languages
objectives.pass_rule: Named reviewer, role, date, SHA, scope and reservations are signed.

objectives.name: final-ci
objectives.target: One final run on the final SHA with all required jobs exit 0 and none skipped
objectives.command: Official final CI workflow on immutable final SHA
objectives.pass_rule: Static, UI, visual, capacity and upgrade all pass; no required job is skipped.
objectives.environment_block_rule: CI unavailable => 75; any skipped required job is FAIL.

objectives.name: official-package
objectives.target: CI package hash equals detached reproducible build hash
objectives.command: Download official package and rebuild detached from the same SHA
objectives.pass_rule: Hashes are identical and package is verified.

objectives.name: final-upgrade-rollback
objectives.target: Upgrade, rollback and second idempotent pass succeed 100%
objectives.command: Run upgrade, rollback and second pass on the final package in disposable environments
objectives.pass_rule: Every assertion, hash, sentinel, data and setting check passes.

objectives.name: staging-cleanup
objectives.target: After explicit authorization, fixture 249 and media 250 are deleted and absent publicly
objectives.command: Delete only after user authorization, then verify IDs and public absence
objectives.pass_rule: Both deletion and public absence checks pass after confirmation.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Before authorization => 77; do not delete automatically.

objectives.name: final-signoffs
objectives.target: 8 named and dated signoffs
objectives.command: Collect independent FR, EN, AR, WCAG, UX, design, operations and product signoffs
objectives.pass_rule: All eight signoffs exist for the same final SHA.
